comment: The Watchlist wave-3 capture list: each ui-sim capture, the board it answers, the dev triggers armed in a fresh instance root, the mock state and the key walk. ONE CAPTURE RECIPE, automated by tools/watchlist_captures.py (`python3 tools/watchlist_captures.py --sim <plxnative-sim> [--out DIR] [--only FILE ...]`): (1) tests/mock_pms.py starts in that process on loopback with authorize_after=2, and `POST /_mock/discover {"list": <mock>}` resets its Discover list to the capture's `mock` mode (`default` is the 14-title fixture, `empty` clears the list, `movies_only` keeps only the movie titles so Type = TV Shows matches nothing); (2) a fresh instance root gets `plxnative-plextv` and `plxnative-discover` aimed at the mock, and a prep boot with `plxnative-login` signs in through the app's own QR flow - the stored mock session is the account, so no `token` trigger is armed (a `token` boot reads the Watchlist as unavailable for the profile); (3) the capture's `triggers` are armed, the simulator boots, waits `boot_wait_s`, sends each key as a FIFO token through `plxnative-remote` with `key_wait_s` between them (`hold` is `okdown`, 1.2 s, `okup`) and then `shot`; (4) the instance root's shot-N.png becomes `<output_dir>/<file>`, and a capture with `expect_write` fails unless the mock logged that write. `compare` names a baseline PNG (651035609 built the same way in a separate worktree) for the reader to put beside the new capture; the driver does not diff it. Build the simulator with `make sim-macos SIM_TDIR=<dir outside the checkout>` (debug; the release build serves as well). Nothing reaches plex.tv, a real server or a television. The PNGs are scratch output, never committed. WAVE 6 (Bump B) captures live under `w6/`: `board` names the Design board each answers; `mock_extra` is merged into the Discover reset (`guids: all` gives every library title a Discover guid so a card's menu offers Add), `unreachable` aims plex.tv at a closed port after the sign-in, and a key `k@0.12` waits 0.12 s instead of key_wait_s (the mid-flip shot). Run it from a release AND a debug simulator and grep each <file>.log/.out for `panic`.

captures.board: DetailOffline (NOT MET: this is the plex.tv-unreachable Detail; the board is the catalog page of a ServerOffline tile, which no sim route reaches yet - see mock key {"pms":"fail"})
